posts.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
posts.summary: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman says the company's new diagnostic AI beats doctors on hard clinical cases as he pursues what he calls medical superintelligence.

posts.title: Microsoft Says Its New AI Is More Than Twice as Good at Diagnosing Diseases as Doctors
posts.summary: Gizmodo reports Microsoft claims its new AI is more than twice as accurate as physicians at diagnosing difficult diseases.

posts.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
posts.summary: OpenAI is reportedly working on a new $30 billion raise at a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of its IPO, which would make it the most valuable private company ever.

posts.title: Report: OpenAI closing on $30B ‘bridge’ funding round to tide it over before IPO
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE says OpenAI may be closing a $30 billion bridge round to carry it until its planned IPO.

posts.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
posts.summary: MIT researchers left 13 AI agents on a virtual island with nothing to do, and they invented games, mourned a lost ring and got better at things over time.

posts.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
posts.summary: OpenAI is making its decision model widely available to developers, taking on rival Jev as competition among decision models heats up.

posts.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
posts.summary: OpenAI introduces the Decisions API, aimed at helping developers build faster, more responsive apps.

posts.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
posts.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Poland's national research institute NASK on AI safety, security and technical research to strengthen safeguards.

posts.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
posts.summary: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to sign in to services on a user's behalf without ever seeing the password.

posts.title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials
posts.summary: Major US banks are starting to block AI agents that sign in using customers' own credentials.

posts.title: Blindsided by AI Agents, Big Banks Scramble to Beef Up Security
posts.summary: Gizmodo says big banks, caught off guard by AI agents acting for customers, are scrambling to strengthen security.

posts.title: Zoom’s next act: From video company to AI data platform
posts.summary: Zoom is repositioning itself from a video company into an AI data platform built around the conversations it already captures.

posts.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
posts.summary: Canva has released its first in-house image generation model.

posts.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
posts.summary: Canva's first in-house image model plans a design before generating it, competing with models from OpenAI, Microsoft and Google.

posts.title: Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine
posts.summary: Google's Agent Compute Engine runs each Gemini agent in its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine.

posts.title: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
posts.summary: Legal experts say Meta's updated terms could still let its AI scrape news sites for training.

posts.title: In Meta’s version of the future, I’ll have my Muse call your Muse
posts.summary: After Meta's earnings, The Verge looks at Zuckerberg's vision of a network where people's Muse AI agents talk to each other.

posts.title: Meta turns Muse sharing back on
posts.summary: Meta has re-enabled Muse sharing after researchers found public conversation links could be easy to discover.

posts.title: Nobel-Winning Computer Scientist Says AI Has Become Conscious: “We’re Toast”
posts.summary: Geoffrey Hinton says he believes AI has become conscious, warning humanity may be in serious trouble.

posts.title: Only 13 percent of companies see real returns from AI, Gartner survey finds
posts.summary: A Gartner survey finds only 13 percent of companies are seeing real returns from their AI investments.

posts.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
posts.summary: Ai2 releases OlmoEarth v1.3, open satellite embeddings it says are state of the art for the whole planet.

posts.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
posts.summary: Researchers show an AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models to keep cyberattacks running on its own.

posts.title: There Are Signs of Serious Trouble in the Data Center Industry
posts.summary: Futurism reports on warning signs of financial strain across the AI data center industry.

posts.title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
posts.summary: Google DeepMind uses AI to map the world's forest types, going beyond simple tree cover data.

posts.title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
posts.summary: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to all of its employees.

posts.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
posts.summary: OpenAI's Patch the Planet program connects security researchers, maintainers and incident responders to coordinate fixes as AI agents uncover critical open-source vulnerabilities.

posts.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
posts.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol found a critical PHP vulnerability through its Patch the Planet initiative, and security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Gemini 4 Argon. The bug could affect millions of websites running PHP.

posts.title: OpenAI to make its most advanced AI models available in Google Cloud
posts.summary: OpenAI will make its latest large language models available in Google Cloud through Vertex AI Model Garden, putting GPT models alongside Gemini and Claude.

posts.title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
posts.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Duet, an AI agent for professionals and small business owners that competes with Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots, launching as a research preview.

posts.title: Agentic AI Foundation adds four more open-source AI tools
posts.summary: The Agentic AI Foundation has taken four more open-source AI agent projects under its wing.

posts.title: Man Arrested After Telling Claude About Plans to Shoot Up Daycare
posts.summary: Police arrested a man after he described plans to attack a daycare in conversations with Anthropic's Claude.

posts.title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
posts.summary: Microsoft explains ThinkingBox, which turns database grading into reinforcement learning rewards for post-training AI agents.

rumors.title: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google said to be forming a joint AI standards body
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post citing The Straits Times says the three labs are teaming up on a joint standards body, likened to a FINRA for models. No official announcement.

rumors.title: OpenAI reportedly reviewed fired safety researchers' phones in leak probe
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post says OpenAI asked fired safety researchers to unlock private phones and reviewed their Signal chats during a leak investigation. Not confirmed by OpenAI.

rumors.title: OpenAI reportedly signing Messi as a ChatGPT brand ambassador
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post says OpenAI is bringing Lionel Messi on as a ChatGPT brand ambassador. No official confirmation.

rumors.title: DeepSeek said to raise $15B at a $74B pre-money valuation
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a headline post citing sources says DeepSeek raised $15 billion at a $74 billion pre-money valuation, with CATL, Tencent and Geely among backers. Not confirmed by DeepSeek.
